scope: Eight annotation-route leads: two GPR158/mGlyR entries and six LGR4 entries. Metadata/prose overlay; no frozen ledger rewrite.

Cryo-EM sample preparation and data acquisition
sources.roleAndConstructFacts: Nb20 was selected from an immunized llama library and tested against receptor-expressing cells and purified receptor ectodomain. The Methods separately describe ectodomain-Fc binding assays and a purified Nb20-mGlyR-RGS7-Gbeta5 cryo-EM sample; the ectodomain assay reagent must not be substituted for the deposited receptor construct. The publication gives an Nb20 sequence and describes tagged recombinant production.
sources.scope: Role, construct/sample and deposition review; structural Results and images excluded from this reviewer output.

sources.roleAndConstructFacts: Methods specify recombinant LGR4 residues 25–833 with an HA signal sequence and Flag tag; full-length LGR4 was used separately for cellular assays. LGR4-selective VHH panning and NB52/NB21 production are described. MB52 combines the NB52 VHH with circularly permuted H. pylori HopQ adhesin scaffold, reported as 58 kDa.

Methods specify LGR4 residues 25–833 with HA signal and Flag tags, receptor-selective VHH preparation, and MB52 generation by fusion of NB52 to circularly permuted HopQ adhesin scaffold, reported as 45 kDa. A nonstructural introductory sentence identifies NB18 as LGR4-targeting. The two papers differ in their reported scaffold mass; this review preserves that discrepancy.
